definitions.explanation: Used to count flat, thin objects such as paper, plates, shirts, tickets, photos, CDs, and sliced items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三枚|さんまい}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are three sheets of paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{五枚|ごまい}⟦{撮|と}りました→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何枚|なんまい}⟦{持|も}っています→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many shirts do you have?

examples.japanese: ⟦お{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{四枚|よんまい}⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百枚|ひゃくまい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せたい→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I took as many as a hundred photos on my trip, so I want to show them to my friends.

notes:
〜{枚|まい} is a counter for thin, flat objects. One of the most common counters in Japanese.

WHAT IT COUNTS:
- {紙|かみ}: paper
- {写真|しゃしん}: photos
- {皿|さら}: plates
- {切符|きっぷ}: tickets
- シャツ: shirts
- CD, DVD
- {布団|ふとん}: futons
- ピザ (slices)

COUNTING:
- {一枚|いちまい}, {二枚|にまい}, {三枚|さんまい}, {四枚|よんまい}, {五枚|ごまい}
- {六枚|ろくまい}, {七枚|ななまい}, {八枚|はちまい}, {九枚|きゅうまい}, {十枚|じゅうまい}
- {何枚|なんまい}: how many (flat things)?

No sound changes occur with this counter.

NOTE: For bound paper (books, notebooks), use 〜{冊|さつ} instead.
